title: Real-estate transaction closing bundle
description: Purchase, title, conveyance, and settlement evidence for a governed closing decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: real-estate-transaction-closing
  title: Real-estate transaction closing bundle
  description: Purchase, title, conveyance, and settlement evidence for a governed closing decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-04
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/real-estate
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [real_property.property_address, property_transaction.purchase_price, title_record.commitment_number, closing.closing_date]
      relationshipIds: [has_party, transfers, evidenced_by, settled_at]
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/purchase_agreement, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/real_estate_transactions_title_commitment, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/deed, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/real_estate/closing_statement, role: supporting }
